publisher_affiliation: Killer In The Keep is an independent project and is not endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.
primary_location: A four-level storm-bound keep with a Cellar, First Floor, Second Floor, Attic/Roof Level, and concealed routes between floors.
interactive_environment: Water, ice, acid, darkness, debris, and pits

door_and_passage_rules.locked_door_legacy: Roll 1d10 with a lockpick; 7 or higher succeeds and a natural 1 loses the lockpick.
door_and_passage_rules.trapped_door_legacy: DC 16 Dexterity saving throw to disarm; failure triggers a trap.
door_and_passage_rules.large_statue_legacy: DC 17 Strength check to move a statue blocking a secret passage.
door_and_passage_rules.dnd_conversion: Use Perception or Investigation to find, thieves' tools to disarm or unlock, and Athletics to force or move obstacles.

grid_rules.accepted_grid_sizes: Any rectangular grid size; tokens, traps, doors, locks, auras, and ranges scale to grid.cell_px and grid.feet_per_square.

token_size_scaling.Tiny: 0.5 square visual / occupies as table allows

pathing_rules.normal: Heroes and monsters path through walkable keep squares.
pathing_rules.secret_passage: Only heroes or monsters with discovered or unlocked access can use the route.
pathing_rules.hazard_square: Movement remains possible unless the hazard says otherwise; resolve its trigger and damage normally.
pathing_rules.locked_door: Blocks movement until opened, picked, forced, destroyed, or bypassed by a qualifying named power.
pathing_rules.stairs: Connect mapped floors and cost normal movement unless the map marks difficult terrain.
